findings.title: Weapon does not lead the front
findings.message: Looking 30 degrees off straight ahead the chassis or a non-ground-game part is -2.8 mm ahead of `blade_c`; the opponent meets it first.
findings.fix: Cut the wedge back or move the weapon forward until it leads by 5-10 mm across plus or minus 30 degrees.

findings.message: `blade_c` stores 7.5 J at 85% speed (0.05 J per gram of robot; warns below 0.10, i.e. 15 J at 150 g).
